8use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

10/**
11 * @mixin \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model
12 * @method static void created(\Closure $callback)
13 * @method static void updated(\Closure $callback)
14 * @method static void deleted(\Closure $callback)
15 */
16trait LogsActivity
17{
18    /**
19     * Boot the trait
20     */
21    /**
22     * @codeCoverageIgnore
23     */
24    public static function bootLogsActivity(): void
25    {
26        // Log lors de la création
27        static::created(function (Model $model) {
28            try {
29                if ($model->shouldLogActivity('created')) {
30                    $model->logActivity('created', null, $model->toArray());
31                }
32            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
33                Log::warning('Activity log failed on created: ' . $e->getMessage());
34            }
35        });
36
37        // Log lors de la mise à jour
38        static::updated(function (Model $model) {
39            try {
40                if ($model->shouldLogActivity('updated')) {
41                    $changes = $model->getChanges();
42                    $original = array_intersect_key($model->getOriginal(), $changes);
43
44                    // Exclure les champs sensibles
45                    $excludeFields = $model->getExcludedLogFields();
46                    $changes = array_diff_key($changes, array_flip($excludeFields));
47                    $original = array_diff_key($original, array_flip($excludeFields));
48
49                    if (!empty($changes)) {
50                        $model->logActivity('updated', $original, $changes);
51                    }
52                }
53            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
54                Log::warning('Activity log failed on updated: ' . $e->getMessage());
55            }
56        });
57
58        // Log lors de la suppression
59        static::deleted(function (Model $model) {
60            try {
61                if ($model->shouldLogActivity('deleted')) {
62                    $model->logActivity('deleted', $model->toArray(), null);
63                }
64            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
65                Log::warning('Activity log failed on deleted: ' . $e->getMessage());
66            }
67        });
68    }

73    public function logActivity(string $action, ?array $oldValues = null, ?array $newValues = null, ?string $description = null): ?ActivityLog
74    {

78            return ActivityLog::create([

83                'subject_id' => (string) $this->getKey(),
84                'description' => $description ?? $this->getActivityDescription($action),
85                'old_values' => $oldValues,
86                'new_values' => $newValues,
87                'properties' => $this->getActivityMetadata(),
88                'ip_address' => request()->ip(),

90            ]);
91        } catch (\Throwable $e) {

93            return null;
94        }
95    }

136    /**
137     * Vérifier si on doit logger cette activité
138     */
139    protected function shouldLogActivity(string $action): bool
140    {

144        if ($loggedTypes === ['*']) {
